init.title: Calendar and service connections
init.description: Select the services to poll. Only selected services will show a separate credentials page. Home Assistant needs internet access to contact their APIs; the calendar and saved history remain local. Optional Obedience settings sync completed days to configured habits; leave them blank to track points only in Home Assistant.
